summary: The full positive-even component-size domain n_i>=2 yields exactly the same three quotients: 9108 candidates, 18 labelled survivors, three orbits, no size-two survivor. Triple-repeat elimination is not a dependency of this widened classification.

context_provenance: Same agent as the completed two-target audit. Independently expanded its row-composition checker from n_i>=4 to n_i>=2 after root reported a separate result. Root code was not used; this reviewer authored the saved checker. This is not a fresh independent semantic review of its own newly saved checker, and no original-graph paper was re-reviewed.
scope: Exact integer classification for three-component quotients only. No actual-graph exclusion proof, D1 annotation claim, other component count or Lean result is included.

details.canonical_statement: For every R in Z_{>=0}^{3x3} with R1=8 1 and trace(R)=7, if R^2+R-10I=1 n^T for positive even n_i and n_i r_ij=n_j r_ji, then (n,R), up to simultaneous component permutation, is one of exactly the three listed output pairs.

obligations.payload: There are exactly 45 nonnegative integer rows (a,b,8-a-b), using a=0..8 and b=0..8-a. Their triple product enumerates every nonnegative integer row-sum-eight 3x3 matrix exactly once (91125 matrices). Filtering the diagonal sum equal to seven leaves exactly 9108 matrices; no prior component-size restriction enters this coverage.

For every trace-seven candidate, the checker computes Q=R^2+R-10I by integer arithmetic. Three identical Q rows define n uniquely. It retains exactly positive even n_i>=2 and checks n_i r_ij=n_j r_ji for all pairs. Row sums imply sum(n)=64+8-10=62, also asserted. There is no n_i>=4, B<=2, D1, or original-graph-exclusion filter.

All six permutations act simultaneously on n and both axes of R; the lexicographic minimum identifies exactly the component-relabelling orbit. The independent row-first enumeration finds 18 labelled solutions, three orbits of six, with sizes (6,24,32), (8,24,30), and (12,20,30). No survivor has size two.

The checker reads the original JSON solely after enumeration. It asserts exact equality of the canonical (sizes,R) set and asserts no repeated reference orbit. It also asserts 9108 tested, 18 labelled solutions and three orbits. D1 labels are ignored and are not part of the comparison.

For any positive-support component C of a symmetric nonnegative integer zero-diagonal repeat matrix with row sum three, 3|C| is twice its total unordered internal repeat weight. Thus |C| is a positive even integer, automatically at least two, without a bound on individual repeat entries. Consequently the new classification domain does not import triple-repeat elimination or B<=2.

The new reusable checker and new min-two output are separate files. The prior discovery script, prior minimum-four JSON and original two-target audit remain unchanged. One standard-library checker run was pinned to one CPU and exited zero.
